newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks leap, energised by weakening yen.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks leap, energised by weakening yen.

text.p: Tokyo stocks leapt in early Monday morning trade, energised by strength in the U.S. markets on Friday and a weakening yen, brokers said.
Investors moved to buy export-strong shares, they said.
They added, however, that the top-side was likely to be capped by selling ahead of Japan's fiscal year-end.

As of 0017 GMT, the Nikkei 225 had clawed past the psychologically important threshold of 18,000, and was up 134.06 points or 0.75 percent at 18,057.70. Its June futures were 160 points higher at 17,990.
